declarations.docstring: A finite-dimensional subrepresentation with bounded basis degrees embeds equivariantly into a polynomial-power representation.
A simple finite-dimensional subrepresentation admits an equivariant embedding into a negative polynomial-power representation.
A finite-dimensional subrepresentation embeds equivariantly into a polynomial-power representation with cofinal weight data.
A simple representation with an injective polynomial-equivariant map embeds into a polynomial representation.
The character of a polynomial representation is a finite weighted sum of displayed terms.
